publisher: Samordna opptak (Norwegian Universities and Colleges Admission Service)
claim: Applications open 1 February and close 15 April at 23:59, with documentation due the same day. Education finished during the spring may be uploaded until 1 July, which is also the last date to change the order of your choices.
excerpt: 1. februar Opent for søking. […] 15. april Ordinær søknadsfrist — 15. april kl. 23.59 er siste frist for å søkje eller legge til fleire studieønske i søknaden din. […] Viss du har søknadsfrist 15. april kl. 23.59, må du laste opp avslutta utdanning og annan dokumentasjon seinast same dato. Utdanning og praksis som du fullfører i vår kan du laste opp fram til 1. juli. […] 1. juli Omprioriteringsfrist. […] Når du får tilbod i hovudopptaket, fell lågare prioriterte studieønske bort.
interpretation: The 1 July date is the last day to upload documentation for education finished during the spring, and the IB publishes results on 6 July. Samordna opptak's IB page (ev-samordna-ib-request-for-results) says how a graduating IB student bridges that: through the IB's Request for Results Service. The page still describes the 2026 round when re-read on 24 September 2026.

publisher: Samordna opptak (Norwegian Universities and Colleges Admission Service)
claim: An IB Diploma gives general admission (generell studiekompetanse) when Norwegian and English are documented. The Norwegian requirement is met by grade 3 or better in Norwegian A, Norwegian B HL, Swedish A or Danish A at higher or standard level; English by English at grade 3 or better or English as the language of instruction.
excerpt: Du dekker kravet i norsk hvis du har karakteren 3 eller bedre i: … Swedish A på higher eller standard level eller Danish A på higher eller standard level
interpretation: Settles the question the profile used to leave open: an IB student with Danish A or Swedish A meets the Norwegian requirement without a Norwegian test.

claim: An IB student graduating in the application year cannot upload the diploma by the 1 July deadline and must instead give the institutions handling the application electronic access to the results through the IB's Request for Results Service, completed with the IB coordinator.
excerpt: Hvis du er avgangselev i år, vil du ikke rekke å laste opp diplomet ditt innen innsendingsfristen 1. juli.
